title: Model ML and Bigdata.com Extend Partnership to Power Financial Workflows with Trusted Data
body_markdown:
Model ML today announced an expansion of its partnership with[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) , the AI grounding layer for finance, built by RavenPack.[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) takes the world's leading business and financial content and makes it AI-ready, with powerful search and precision retrieval.


[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) users at the world's largest financial institutions have already been accessing Model ML's proprietary Global Filings data on the platform. Now, the integration runs both ways.


Model ML users with a[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) license can pull licensed content and analytics directly into Model ML, including premium news, podcasts, expert interviews, filings and transcripts, and entity-level sentiment. This gives the custom agents they build richer context and full source attribution for memos, models, and client deliverables.


**Live now** for all Model ML users with a[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) license.


#### **Use cases**[Bigdata.com](http://bigdata.com/) **can power within Model ML:**


-


**Sentiment Tracker** - Monitor market sentiment using live signal from 10M+ monthly documents, and better understand the real-time drivers behind emerging trends.


-


**Company Briefs** - Get a full company overview spanning fundamentals, filings, and press releases, so you spend less time aggregating and more time analyzing.


-


**Thematic Exposure Scan** - Understand thematic exposure from every angle, across filings, premium news, analyst research, and alternative data.
